name: Prima Donna
source:
A girl decides to try getting into the streaming world herself after her best friend suggested it to her. She stares at the rabbit hole of depravity and threads hesitantly. Soon she realizes her paranoia grew and it became the catalyst for her to finally want out. But her rabid fans wouldn't accept that. She starts encountering pleads to return to streaming in her everyday life and these pleads turning into threats. Every week the girl receives mysterious e-mails from an unknown sender. She starts to feel uneasy as this mysterious stalker could be anyone who’s trying to kidnap her, and they are only getting more dangerous each passing day...

A halloween party, the perfect circumstances for an ultimatum under the guise of the festivities...

[From [url=https://aaryatan.itch.io/primadonna]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在她最好的朋友向她推荐后，一个女孩决定尝试自己进入流媒体世界。她盯着堕落的兔子洞，犹豫着。很快，她意识到自己的偏执增多，这成为她最终想要离开的催化剂。但她的狂热粉丝不会接受这一点。她开始在日常生活中遇到一些请求返回流媒体的请求，而这些请求变成了威胁。每周，这个女孩都会收到来自未知发件人的神秘电子邮件。她开始感到不安，因为这个神秘的跟踪者可能是任何试图绑架她的人，而且他们只会变得越来越危险……

万圣节派对，在庆祝活动的幌子下发出最后通牒的完美环境……
